first.rationale: Onboarding completion and activation are both currently declining, and prior evidence indicates that shortening onboarding and reducing signup friction durably improved early activation and time-to-value. This directly supports sustainable qualified revenue without relying on potentially margin-eroding price competition. Verify the two relevant source records before committing to the experiment design.

final.rationale: Run a shortened onboarding experiment, prioritizing the proven completion and time-to-value improvements from exp_86. It directly addresses both current declines and previously improved 30-day retention (+3%). Use SMB signup-field reduction only where applicable, since exp_31 was SMB-specific and showed a small retention decline despite qualified-revenue lift. Measure qualified revenue and retention alongside completion and activation before any rollout.
